reviewAuthority: producer self-review; not an independent final review

findings.problem: Workspace could silently normalize an unknown timeline role and did not validate ancestry invariants.
findings.resolution: Reject unknown roles; require one primary; validate aspect, timestamps, createdFrom references and cycles.

findings.problem: A destination parent symlink could redirect timeline duplication outside the Workspace root.
findings.resolution: Resolve the nearest existing ancestor with realpath and enforce containment before exclusive creation.

findings.problem: A project bundle could retain absolute local paths in nested metadata.
findings.resolution: Replace bound media paths, summarize provenance and recursively reject any remaining absolute path before atomic publication.

findings.problem: One-second revision polling expanded and hashed every Workspace timeline.
findings.resolution: Revision polling reads only the active Timeline; Workspace expansion is reserved for explicit project reads.

findings.problem: Premiere XML was initially an FCPXML alias rather than a distinct Premiere interchange candidate.
findings.resolution: Generate Final Cut Pro 7 XML xmeml v5 with linked video/audio clipitems, file URL, rate, geometry and Kacha metadata.

findings.problem: Encoder presence could overstate H.264/H.265/ProRes as end-to-end available.
findings.resolution: Keep codec delivery capability partial until every profile is connected to final render, QC and review; profile availability now means runtime encoder evidence only.

findings.problem: Agent Activity assumed every historical record contained requiredQc.
findings.resolution: Render old journal entries with a safe none fallback.

findings.problem: ripple/overwrite could invalidate executed transition semantics or accept structured semantic metadata.
findings.resolution: Fail closed on executed transitions and audit semantic fields as bounded strings or null.

findings.problem: Workbench controls became visible before capability and delivery data finished loading, allowing an empty drawer race.
findings.resolution: Keep capability, delivery and activity controls disabled until their corresponding session data is ready; browser acceptance waits for mounted capability content.

claimBoundary: This historical producer review closed its listed local findings but is not independent final-review evidence. A fresh R2 producer review records later findings; target NLE import, creator value, independent final review and production release remain external evidence.
